messages:
Lina: Morning team — kickoff for BrightHealth onboarding. Goal: get production traffic by Sep 1. Need to lock stakeholders, success criteria, and a rollout timeline.
Raj: Procurement says license signed today. Billing contact will be @Kelsey from their finance team.
Sofia: I'll own integration acceptance. Primary dependency: access to BrightHealth staging VPC and sample dataset.
Tom: I'll scope VPC peering + firewall rules. ETA: 3 business days after creds.
Emma: I'll draft enablement playbook and a 60/90/180-day adoption plan.
Lina: Success criteria proposal:
```
- p95 gen latency <= 450ms on 8k tokens/day test
- 0 critical reliability incidents for 30 days after go-live
- 75% of target user flows validated by their PM team
- Cost/unit within agreed SLO (±10%)
```
Raj: Risk flag — they plan a heavy embedding batch job in week 2. Recommend throttling config + canary.
Sofia: Timeline (high level):
1) Week 0: creds + staging VPC
2) Week 1: model mapping, small canary
3) Week 2–4: scale + enablement workshops
4) Week 5–8: performance tuning + go-live
Tom: I'll add an infra task list to the shared board. Need CIDRs and expected QPS.
Lina: Action items:
- Raj: share billing + legal contact (due EOD)
- Tom: staging network checklist (due in 3d)
- Emma: enablement slide deck + playbook draft (due in 7d)
- Sofia: acceptance test matrix (due in 5d)
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: BrightHealth Kickoff — Fri 10:00am PT — invite sent to all participants.
Raj: Pinged Kelsey, waiting on their SSO admin to grant Okta access.
Emma: I'll prepare a short customer-facing runbook and a 30-min training for their SREs.
Lina: Good. Let's reconvene after we have creds. Call out any blockers here. :rocket:
